verdict.rationale: An API with UI parity is a fair question for a SaaS personal-assistant product, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents conversational interfaces (phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack) and a web app, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path. No public programmatic API is evidenced, let alone one matching what the UI can do.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
